title: Understanding K-means Convergence
text: In K-means clustering, convergence is achieved when the cluster centers no longer change significantly between iterations. This usually means that the labels assigned to each data point remain the same.

title: Cluster Centers and Labels
text: If the cluster centers change but the labels do not, it indicates that the data points are still closest to the same centers as before. This is a sign of convergence.
